systems.name: 3.1 Painting Textures in Blockbench
systems.notes: Use the built‑in paint tool to create pixel‑art textures directly on your model.
tasks: Create a new texture for a model
Paint faces using the fill, brush, and shape tools
Use layers to organise your painting
Export the texture as a PNG

systems.name: 3.2 External Image Editing
systems.notes: Work with Photoshop / GIMP / Aseprite alongside Blockbench.
tasks: Paint the texture in an external editor
Re‑import the texture and see the updates

systems.name: 3.3 Advanced UV Techniques
systems.notes: Mirror UVs, atlasing, and texture optimisation.
tasks: Mirror one half of a symmetrical model
Pack multiple UV islands onto one texture sheet
Use the Auto‑UV tools for complex shapes
